summary: Pivot from overnight/1.5-day to 3/4-day trips (caught 105 YT in S1 vs 9 for premiums). Prioritize San Diego, Malihini, Mission Belle boats.
describe: Season 1 data: 3/4-day trips caught 105 YT (77% of total catch). Overnight and 1.5-day caught 9 YT total. Strategy: book 3/4-day trips ($150 each) whenever available, targeting 70% of budget. Prefer boats with recent 3/4-day success. Commit PTO for weekday 3/4-day trips to spread risk across dates. Use half-days only if 3/4-day not available and budget remains.
